name: enableMask
meaning: 16 enable bits indexed by designer slot (0..14); init 0xFFFF; msg 0xD00 rewrites it

name: entrySlot
meaning: designer slot index (CAMERAnn - 1) of each entry; 0xFF unused

name: scriptActive
meaning: 1 after this manager started a scripted camera; on exit it calls Camera_ReleaseAny
